name: Nozomi
source:
Advisor to the "Salvation Committee".
Her duties include intelligence gathering, strategy planning, health management—supporting the newly-summoned members in both professional and personal matters.
Though her expression rarely changes, she holds deep affection for the Committee members. Her utmost respect and genuine affection shine through in countless small ways.
Almost nothing is known about her private life beyond her advisory duties.
One thing is certain: she is a good person.

[Translated from [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/hajiron/character/chara05.php]official website[/url]]
